summary: Frontend regression on new messaging flow (admin activate/deactivate conversation, candidate conditional access, AI vs recruiter separation, unread dividers). CRITICAL BLOCKER: Admin > Messages page is completely broken due to multiple undefined references inside the Messages() component of /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.js. The page renders a full-screen CRA runtime error overlay and NONE of the admin messaging flows (new-conv-select, toggle-conv-active, admin-chat-input, admin-chat-send, admin-unread-divider) can be exercised. Because admin cannot activate the conversation, the candidate-side flows (recruiter-chat-card visibility, chat-locked-notice, unread-divider) cannot be validated either. Testing agent identified and patched ONE of the missing pieces (firstUnread state + destructure of {messages, first_unread} in the messages loader), but the remaining bugs are business-logic implementation gaps that the main agent must fix.

ui_bugs.issue:
CRITICAL — Multiple undefined references throw ReferenceError on render, producing a full-screen 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay as soon as nav-messages is clicked. Confirmed by testing agent in two consecutive runs:
  1) `firstUnread is not defined` — PATCHED by testing agent (added `const [firstUnread, setFirstUnread] = useState(null);` and updated the /chat/messages loader to destructure `data.messages` and `data.first_unread`).
  2) `startConv is not defined` — STILL BROKEN. Line 897 uses `<Select onValueChange={startConv}>` but there is NO `startConv` function anywhere in the file. Needed to start a new conversation with a candidate (should POST to backend to create/activate the conv and setActive(newConv)).
  3) `candidates is not defined` — STILL BROKEN (will throw once startConv is fixed). Line 900 iterates `candidates.map(...)` but `candidates` is only declared inside another component (Interviews, line 1167). Messages() needs its own `const [candidates, setCandidates] = useState([]); useEffect(() => api.get('/candidates').then(...))` block.
  4) `toggleActive` variable-shadow bug — Line 945 wires `onClick={toggleActive}` inside Messages(), but the ONLY toggleActive in scope is the OUTER-file function defined at line 304 for jobs: `const toggleActive = async (j) => { ... /api/jobs/{id}/toggle }`. Clicking the header button will therefore try to toggle a job, NOT hit `PUT /api/chat/conversations/{candidate_id}/active`. A local `toggleActive` (or renamed `toggleConvActive`) must be defined inside Messages() that calls the correct endpoint and refreshes convs/active.

rca of the issue: Root cause: The Messages() component of AdminDashboard.js was extended for the new messaging features (activate/deactivate, unread divider, new-conv-select) but only PARTIALLY wired: JSX references `startConv`, `candidates`, `firstUnread` and `toggleActive` (as a conv-toggle) without declaring/importing them inside the component's scope. React renders → JS evaluates the JSX → ReferenceError thrown → CRA overlay covers the entire page → all downstream data-testids for admin messaging are unmountable. Reproduction: log in as admin → click [data-testid='nav-messages'] → overlay: 'firstUnread is not defined' (before patch) / 'startConv is not defined' (after firstUnread patch). Mitigation: implement startConv, add local candidates state+fetch, rename inner conv-toggle to avoid shadowing the outer toggleActive(job). Keep firstUnread patch already applied. Enable ESLint no-undef in CI.
